title: Text Processing
summary: The text_processing module provides the foundational `PreTrainedTokenizerBase` class for handling text tokenization, including encoding, decoding, and managing special tokens for various natural language processing models.

nodes.label: PreTrainedTokenizerBase
nodes.title: PreTrainedTokenizerBase
nodes.description: The base class for all tokenizer backends, providing core functionalities for text tokenization, special token management, and conversion between text and token IDs.

nodes.label: Load Pretrained Tokenizer
nodes.title: from_pretrained
nodes.description: Instantiates a tokenizer from a predefined model, handling file loading, caching, and configuration.

nodes.label: Save Tokenizer State
nodes.title: save_pretrained
nodes.description: Saves the full tokenizer state, including configuration and vocabulary, to a specified directory for later reloading.

nodes.label: Tokenize Text
nodes.title: tokenize
nodes.description: Converts a string into a sequence of tokens, replacing unknown tokens with a designated unknown token.

nodes.label: Encode Text to IDs
nodes.title: encode
nodes.description: Converts text into a sequence of integer IDs, applying padding and truncation strategies as needed.

nodes.label: Decode IDs to Text
nodes.title: decode
nodes.description: Converts a sequence of token IDs back into a human-readable string, with options to skip special tokens and clean up spaces.

nodes.label: Apply Chat Template
nodes.title: apply_chat_template
nodes.description: Formats a conversation history into a tokenized sequence using a Jinja chat template, suitable for chat models.

nodes.label: Pad Sequences
nodes.title: pad
nodes.description: Pads a single encoded input or a batch of encoded inputs to a uniform length, according to specified padding strategies.

groups.label: Core Tokenizer API
groups.title: Core Tokenizer API
groups.description: This group encompasses the fundamental methods for initializing, saving, and performing basic tokenization operations.

groups.label: Text to ID Conversion
groups.title: Text to ID Conversion
groups.description: This group handles the process of converting raw text into numerical token IDs, including tokenization, encoding, and padding.

groups.label: ID to Text Conversion
groups.title: ID to Text Conversion
groups.description: This group manages the process of converting numerical token IDs back into human-readable text.

groups.label: Chat Templating
groups.title: Chat Templating
groups.description: This group provides functionality for formatting conversational inputs using predefined chat templates, essential for chat-based models.
